quotes.quote: Most dietary supplement ingredients have no independent quality standard. Niagen Bioscience spent over six years sponsoring the scientific work required to create one. The U.S. Pharmacopeia—the independent authority behind prescription drug standards—has now published an official monograph for NR Chloride. Niagen, our patented ingredient, is compliant with that standard. Tested, trusted, and recognized by global regulatory bodies. The gold standard in NAD+ science is here.

We proudly hold an A2LA accreditation to ISO/IEC 17025:2017, representing a comprehensive assessment of different aspects of our laboratory operations. A2LA's rigorous evaluation process examines everything from technical competence and precision to quality management systems.
